coverage.scope: All explicitly bachelor-labeled undergraduate catalog A-Z entries, including named concentration variants and LPS BAAS, plus five coordinated undergraduate dual degrees
coverage.exclusions: Retain each A-Z entry with BA, BAS, BSE, BS, BSN, BFA or BAAS award suffix, including separately published tracks；Exclude minors, certificates, graduate/submatriculation continuations and generic advising categories；Retain paused Fine Arts BFA with eligibility note；Coordinated dual-degree page names five integrated two-bachelor programs; retain these but do not invent every possible uncoordinated double degree
gaps: A-Z granularity includes concentrations and is not a count of distinct university-wide degree subjects
Specific campus, delivery language and duration left null unless stated on read source
